baseline.path: data/Hungry F&B Database.Public Access 2026-10-17 Verified Menu Catalogue Refresh 40.xlsx

scope.method: Bounded cross-check of current public mall directory evidence against exact SFA licence/name/location records in the baseline. Only propose missing outlets where the tenant and specific outlet location are corroborated. Existing same-brand records at another unit/location are not treated as a match.

findings.source_observation: Current official dining guide reports 150 dining results; results include branch/unit locations.
findings.baseline_crosscheck: 234 directory records use exact six-digit postal code 098585. The workbook contains extensive matching active SFA licence rows for this mall; no distinct missing outlet established in this bounded pass.
findings.unresolved: Large food-court and tenant listings cannot be exhaustively paired by tenant name from the rendered listing alone.

findings.source_observation: Current official Food & Beverages directory reports 54 stores; initial page view is paginated.
findings.baseline_crosscheck: 89 directory records use postal code 238895. No distinct missing outlet established from the visible official listing in this pass.
findings.unresolved: Not every dynamically loaded store was independently joined.

findings.source_observation: Current official Dining directory contains F&B tenant listings with units; mall address is 3 Temasek Boulevard, Singapore 038983.
findings.baseline_crosscheck: 203 directory records use postal code 038983. No distinct missing outlet established from the listing cross-check in this pass.
findings.unresolved: Some listed entries are food halls or branded concessions where a mall-level match does not establish individual stall coverage.

findings.source_observation: Current official directory lists Food & Beverages tenants and advises checking tenant sources for updated hours.
findings.baseline_crosscheck: 103 directory records use postal code 449269. No distinct missing outlet established from the visible listing in this pass.
findings.unresolved: The listing is dynamically paginated; not all directory tenants were independently joined.

findings.source_observation: Current Link REIT directory lists Food & Beverage tenants across JP1 and JP2. Exact EAT. outlet page gives JP1 #JP201-76/77/78.
findings.baseline_crosscheck: 206 catalogue records mention Jurong Point in Full Address. No record at 1 Jurong West Central 2 #01-76/77/78 was found. A separate SFA record named EAT exists at 63 Jurong West Central 3, so a same-brand record exists at a different address and is not treated as this outlet.
findings.unresolved: No SFA licence for the JP1 #01-76/77/78 outlet is present in the baseline.
